title: Fable subagents stall with "no progress for 600s" three times in a row; Opus subagents in the same session complete
details:
- **What happened:** Three consecutive background subagents launched with `model: "fable"` ended with `Agent stalled: no progress for 600s (stream watchdog did not recover)`. The first stalled after emitting a 21 KB Write tool call that never executed (file absent on disk, content recoverable from the transcript). The second stalled after 13 read-only Bash calls, the third after 21 Bash calls, both without file changes. Six Opus subagents in the same session completed normally. No hung child processes (psql/less) were found afterwards.
- **What the user said:** User didn't comment; observed by the model.
- **Repro:** Launch an Agent with subagent_type general-purpose, model fable, a long prompt (~1.5k words) involving many Bash calls (psql, stripe CLI, curl) against a local stack; wait ~10 min.
- **Evidence:** task ids a993868ec93765c44, ad1d556c54c728e45, accdc50dbc59d8dc1; transcripts under ~/.claude/projects/-Users-brianboy--superset-worktrees-cc3901ca-…/98750cb7-…/subagents/; session 2026-09-16/17.
